head: aead2cde6
summary: The telegraph blocker is fixed: marigold edge over a black ink band reads 9.2-9.6:1 edge-to-ink and 4.0-4.7:1 ink-to-ground on RIFT and BRIDGE, measured frozen with my own classifier. World bands, fog, GFX-5 and value_probe all reproduce. The fix-1 character light (fill 1.39, floor 0.42) has a new problem: it flattens the fighters. Their darkest quarter now sits at about L* 52, which is the lane's value. Internal value spread (median top-quarter minus bottom-quarter L*) fell from 62 at wave 1 to 24. In A/B frames, kits read as one pastel mass, and in the greyscale BRIDGE frame fighters merge with the stone. units_gate fails harder: 52 fails, the lilac rule is at 18.3, and P1 pair confusions are up. The matrix and the wave-1 idle A/B were not finished in this pass.

Own frozen probe, seed 11, edge/ink/ground WCAG: RIFT lane 9.35/4.73 (wave-1 edge-on-ground 2.75), camp 9.59/3.98 (3.34), river 9.19/4.70 (2.77); BRIDGE 9.49/4.13 and 9.38/4.38 (3.21, 2.81); FRAY ink-to-ground 4.18/4.31.

doneWhen.line: Fighters: zone C >= 70 % albedo, top-25 <= 80, units_gate passes, lilac dE76 >= 25
doneWhen.numbers: My units_gate run (seeds 7/11/23 x 3 seatings, 262 s) FAILs with 52 fails: P1 pair 25, P1 near-neutral 9, P4 15, P2 3, P3 0. Dunsom-Vashil dE76 min 18.3 / median 20.2 (wave-1 light 28.9). Top-25 72.3-81.2 (sukri 81.2 is over 80 on this gate). The fighter value spread collapsed. Median top-bottom L*: wave-1 62.3, round 1 50.1, round 2 33.5, fix 1 24.0 (mine 23.8, min 15.5). The darkest quarter is around L* 52, against a lane of 50-51.
My paired Noonline run gives dE76 20.4 lit / 18.5 fogged (wave-1 11.3 / 10.1).
